title: Website Screenshot API input
description: Paste website URLs and get full-page or viewport screenshots (PNG or JPEG) and optional PDFs. Each rendered page is one billable screenshot; pages that fail to load are reported free of charge.

urls.title: Website URLs
urls.description: One URL per line. The scheme is optional (`example.com` works). Duplicates are removed.

device.title: Device preset
device.description: Viewport, pixel density and user agent preset. Choose `custom` to set width, height and scale factor yourself.

fullPage.title: Full page
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of just the first screen.

format.title: Image format
format.description: PNG is lossless; JPEG files are much smaller and support the quality setting.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide the most common cookie / consent pop-ups (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi, Usercentrics, Quantcast and 60+ others) with CSS before capturing. Nothing is clicked or accepted.

renderPdf.title: Also render a PDF
renderPdf.description: Additionally save the page as a PDF (billed as a separate PDF event).

pdfFormat.title: PDF paper size
pdfFormat.description: Paper size used when rendering PDFs.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Emulate `prefers-color-scheme: dark` so sites with a dark theme render it.

viewportWidth.title: Viewport width (custom)
viewportWidth.description: Only used with the `custom` device preset.

viewportHeight.title: Viewport height (custom)
viewportHeight.description: Only used with the `custom` device preset.

deviceScaleFactor.title: Device scale factor (custom)
deviceScaleFactor.description: 1 = standard, 2 = retina, 3 = high-density phone. Only used with the `custom` preset.

waitUntil.title: Wait until
waitUntil.description: When the page is considered ready. `networkidle` additionally waits (up to 15 s) for background requests to settle after the load event, which gives the most complete render.

delayMs.title: Extra delay (ms)
delayMs.description: Additional wait after the page is ready, for animations or late scripts.

autoScroll.title: Scroll before capture
autoScroll.description: Scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images render in full-page screenshots.

hideSelectors.title: Hide elements (CSS selectors)
hideSelectors.description: Extra CSS selectors to hide before capturing, e.g. `.chat-widget`, `#newsletter-popup`.

clipSelector.title: Capture only this element (CSS selector)
clipSelector.description: Screenshot a single element, e.g. `#pricing-table`, instead of the page.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to render in parallel. Each browser tab uses roughly 200 to 400 MB of memory.

timeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a page after this long.

maxRetries.title: Retries per page
maxRetries.description: Retry a page that failed to load this many times before reporting it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use Apify Proxy for sites that block cloud IP addresses or to render geo-specific content. Proxy traffic is billed by Apify separately.
